title: Weekday emphasis stack
description: Splits the date into two lines: the weekday alone, larger and inked, sits above the day-and-month in the existing small muted style. Gives "Domingo" its own visual weight as the primary orientation cue, with the numeric date as secondary detail.

changes.intent: Expose weekday and day/month as separate values instead of one combined string, so the template can lay them out as two lines.
changes.detail: Split the single formatted date string into formattedWeekday ('Domingo') and formattedDayMonth ('23 de agosto'), both still from Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-CR', ...) with capitalization applied, reusing the existing long weekday/month options.

changes.intent: Render the date as a two-line stack: weekday on its own line, day/month beneath.
changes.detail: Wrap the two values in nested spans: {{ formattedWeekday }}{{ formattedDayMonth }}, with .screen__clock-date set to display:flex; flex-direction:column.

changes.intent: Give the weekday primary visual weight — inked, heavier, slightly larger than the current muted date text.
Keep the day/month as secondary, muted detail beneath the weekday.
